title: Snapshot-driven canary promotion and version fencing for private control planes
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: implement a reproducible, snapshot-driven canary promotion flow for private (VPC) control plane upgrades that integrates with our Terraform IaC, enforces version fences, and provides automatic health gating. The feature should enable: 1) deterministic snapshots of control-plane state and config before upgrades, 2) staged promotion of new control-plane versions to small tenant cohorts with traffic-shaping, 3) automated health checks and diff-based assertions against snapshots (API latency, reconciliation errors, operator restarts, config drift), 4) automatic rollback and fence conditions to prevent partial fleet skew, 5) Terraform module authoring patterns for idempotent staged rollouts and rollback hooks. The work includes design, Terraform module updates, orchestration controller changes, health-check library, dashboards, and runbook/playbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Can create a snapshot of control-plane config + observed cluster state (CRs, operator status, ingresses) and store in versioned S3 path via terraform-provisioned storage
Orchestrator can schedule a staged promotion to a tenant cohort (1%, 10%, 50%) and apply new control-plane version tags via IaC without manual cluster recreation
Automated canary health-check suite runs against promoted cohort and emits pass/fail signals to the promotion controller within configurable windows
Promotion controller enforces 'version fence' rules: blocks promotion if dependent node/agent versions mismatch beyond policy thresholds
If any health-check threshold breached, system triggers automated rollback and marks offending snapshot as quarantined with metadata for post-mortem
Terraform modules documented with example usage and e2e test harness; PR merged and internal canary run completed in staging
tasks: Design snapshot schema for control-plane state (CRs, configmaps, secrets metadata, operator conditions)
Extend terraform/private-modules to provision versioned snapshot buckets and lifecycle policies
Implement snapshot capture/restore CLI in controlplane-ops service
Build promotion controller that reads snapshot, applies version tags, and coordinates tenant traffic slice
Author health-check library (latency, reconciliation-rate, operator-restarts, API-error-rate) and wire into controller
Add fence logic for agent/node version compatibility checks
Create dashboards and alerts for canary cohorts (Grafana, Loki queries)
Write rollback playbook and runbook for SRE/solutions teams
End-to-end tests and a staged canary in CI and staging environment
comments: 2026-01-12 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to snapshot + 2-stage promotion (1% -> 25%) with manual rollback hook. Decision: snapshot storage will be versioned S3 with lifecycle 90 days.
2026-01-20 - Design review: PM and SRE requested additional fence for 'agent-sidecar' protocols. Action: add compatibility matrix and blocking rule for >2 minor-version skew.
2026-01-27 - Engineering: Terraform module initial draft pushed (link in links). Waiting on infra team to approve IAM roles for service account that writes snapshots.
2026-02-05 - Implementation: promotion controller prototype created. Uses traffic-slicing via routing tag on tenant metadata rather than direct network mirroring to avoid networking changes.
2026-02-11 - QA: health-check suite added. Found a race where operator restart flaps during snapshot restore; added 30s stabilization window to checks.
2026-02-18 - Security review requested; SSO/KMS integration required for snapshot metadata (sensitive fields redacted). Security comments addressed in PR.
2026-02-22 - Code review: PR comments about idempotency in Terraform apply. Diego addressed drift detection by including idempotent null_resource with local-exec guard.

2026-02-23 - Next steps: schedule internal canary in staging (cohort A) for 2026-02-28. Post-canary retrospective planned; include metrics: p50/p95 control-plane API latency, reconciliation errors, and operator restart counts.
